claims.claim: AUTHOR_TASK has a handoff-free new-TASK and revision mutation path using direct final-contract validation and canonical/provenance guards, without audit composition, stage validation, fingerprints, ledger validation or audited freshness reconstruction.
AUTHOR_TASK rejects supplied audited_handoff fields, including explicit null at parsing, and rejects non-null handoffs before mutation or replay.

Direct TASK validation retains schema, identity, revision, minimum-sufficient verification, affinity, expected-main and unrelated-delta guards, with main rechecks and expected-old-main compare-and-swap.

Revision-1 ORIGIN_AFFINE authoring retains independent admitted-proof validation and rechecks, preserving exact carrier-attempt, TASK, main, route/generation, envelope-digest, HMAC, freshness, replay and legacy/revision separation.
AUTHOR_REMEDIATION and AUTHOR_REPAIR retain audited-handoff validation, canonical reconstruction, correction-lineage and freshness checks.
The three normative documents define direct AUTHOR_TASK admission, preserve mandatory two-stage Brain semantic audit, and explicitly mark historical AUTHOR_TASK H1/H3 mutation gates superseded.

Focused regression tests cover handoff-free TASK authoring, handoff rejection, direct safety and provenance failures, concurrent main mutation, production carrier behavior and preserved correction audit enforcement.
